aiReview.summary: Official vendor Black Friday page for a macOS menu-bar app that monitors AI coding-agent sessions, with a coupon-code lifetime-licence sale from 2 Nov through 1 Dec 2026 (or until a capped number of orders).
evidence: Fetched excerpt title: Perch Black Friday 2026.
Excerpt states 2 Nov to 1 Dec 2026, Pacific time, or until 500 orders, code BLACKFRIDAY2026.
Official URL is vendor path /black-friday, not a roundup or affiliate-only landing.
Sale window ends 2026-12-01, after Black Friday week 2026 start (2026-11-23).
uncertainty: Whether the 500-order cap is already exhausted at listing time.
Ongoing Polar checkout availability and refund practice beyond the FAQ claim.
aiReview.tagline: Mac menu bar for AI coding-agent sessions
aiReview.description: Watch AI coding agents on your Mac and approve waits from Mac, iPhone, or Watch. Black Friday lifetime licence via coupon through 1 Dec 2026.
pros: Vendor page https://perch.run/black-friday titles the offer Black Friday 2026 and lists dates 2 Nov to 1 Dec 2026.
Deal uses code BLACKFRIDAY2026 for a one-time Mac licence (solo or per team seat), limited to the first 500 orders.
Product is a macOS 13+ menu-bar app for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other listed coding agents, with iPhone and Apple Watch companions.
Page documents checkout on Polar, refunds, and that Perch Pro is a separate iPhone subscription not covered by the Mac code.
cons: The Mac discount is capped at 500 orders and may end before 1 Dec 2026.
Licence is one Mac at a time; Perch Pro conversation/reply features are not included in the Mac code.
